{ "rules": [
    "Model forecasts lag behind price turning points, underestimating momentum in uptrends and overreacting in downtrends",
    "Sentiment extremes (0.00 or 1.00) signal mean reversion where model predictions overshoot current levels",
    "When sentiment is mixed (0.33-0.67), model should follow price momentum rather than reverse it",
    "Increasing price trends with positive sentiment (0.00→0.67) require faster forecast acceleration",
    "Decreasing price trends with negative sentiment (1.00→0.00) require faster forecast deceleration",
    "Model exhibits excessive smoothing - forecasts are too close to recent prices, lacking genuine prediction range",
    "Sentiment alignment: positive sentiment should pull forecasts up, negative sentiment should pull forecasts down, misalignment indicates model failure"
] }
